description.en: Floating photo companion for the DSH Web UI with a 15/25/45/60-minute focus timer, water and stretch reminders, Open-Meteo weather, and a session radar listing running, ended, input-waiting and permission-requesting conversations for one-click navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的悬浮照片陪伴插件：15/25/45/60 分钟专注计时、喝水与站立提醒、Open-Meteo 天气，以及列出运行中、刚结束、等待输入和请求权限会话的「会话雷达」，点击即可跳转。
